title: Probability-Signature Dynamics: Unpacking Modular Addition Learning Within Two-Layer Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.11833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks trained on modular addition tasks often develop Fourier-structured representations that support exact generalization. While prior work has identified these Fourier circuits, the mechanism by which gradient-based training selects them from the data distribution remains unclear. We address this question using probability signatures, which express leading gradient interactions through conditional statistics of the training distribution. For modular addition, these signatures are cyclic shift operators and are diagonalized by the discrete Fourier transform, yielding approximately decoupled Fourier-mode dynamics. This explains the emergence of Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, and phase alignment. The same framework resolves a puzzle under label noise: corrupted examples can show faster early loss decrease than clean examples, despite lacking a coherent generalization rule. translated_title: 概率签名动力学：解析二层网络中的模加法学习
translated_abstract: 在模加法任务上训练的神经网络通常会发展出支持精确泛化的傅里叶结构化表示。尽管先前的工作已经识别出这些傅里叶电路，但基于梯度的训练是如何从数据分布中选择出它们的机制仍不清楚。我们使用“概率签名”来回答这一问题，它通过训练分布的条件统计量来表达最主要的梯度交互作用。对于模加法任务，这些概率签名是循环移位算子，并可被离散傅里叶变换对角化，从而产生近似解耦的傅里叶模式动力学。这解释了傅里叶稀疏性、频率匹配和相位对齐等现象的出现。同一框架还解决了标签噪声下的一个谜题：损坏的样本在训练早期可以表现出比干净样本更快的损失下降，尽管它们并不蕴含连贯的泛化规则。我们证明噪声会增加条件标签共（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“概率签名”框架，通过训练分布的条件统计量揭示二层网络在模加法任务中如何被梯度训练自发选择出傅里叶电路，从而统一解释傅里叶稀疏性、频率匹配、相位对齐以及标签噪声下损坏样本早期损失下降反而更快的谜题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "probability signature" framework, showing how conditional statistics of the training distribution guide gradient-based training in two-layer networks to select Fourier circuits for modular addition, thereby explaining Fourier sparsity, frequency matching, phase alignment, and the counterintuitively faster early loss decrease on noisy examples.
